body.html: Zwahotel Amnatcharoen, known locally as Zwa Hotel, is a small budget hotel at 159 Moo 5, Bung Subdistrict, in Mueang Amnat Charoen district · It is a simple, price-first place built mainly around cheap daily rooms — no fancy design and not a long facilities list · Its honest selling point is being among the lowest prices in town for anyone who just needs somewhere to lay their head for one night.

Rooms come in both fan and AC versions · Fan rooms start in the high two-hundreds of baht, while AC rooms start at around ฿320 and up · Every room has an en-suite bathroom and free Wi-Fi, and the in-room kit is basic but functional · These are rooms for travellers who are genuinely watching the budget and are not expecting new furniture or a spacious layout · For the price, it is straightforward — a room with a roof over your head at a price you can reach.
"Very cheap, with both fan and AC rooms, easy parking and late check-in possible. It's a simple place to sleep for a night on the road — not fancy, but the price matches what you pay."

On location, Zwahotel sits in Bung Subdistrict, about 2 km from the centre of Amnat Charoen · It has parking and a 24-hour front desk, which works for self-drivers or anyone arriving late · It is not far from Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park (the city's landmark seated Buddha), with the town centre a short drive away · There are shops and a few eateries around for food, though it is quieter than the heart of town.

Facilities here are the basics of a budget hotel · There is free Wi-Fi in every room, an on-site mini-mart/shop, and parking · The front desk is open 24 hours, so late check-in is fine · There is no pool or gym, and most rates do not include breakfast — all normal at this price point, where simplicity is the trade for a low rate.

To be straight, per the real reviews: this is a genuinely budget stay, not a hotel that leans on looks or polished service · Some reviews mention the building and rooms looking old and very plain, and room condition that is uneven from room to room, and scores on some platforms are not high · If you expect a brand-new room, a soft bed or central-hotel service, this is not it — but if the brief is the cheapest possible price and just a bed for one night, it answers on price.

In short, Zwahotel Amnatcharoen suits anyone on a genuinely tight budget who just wants a cheap daily room in Amnat Charoen · It has both fan and AC rooms to match your budget, parking and a 24-hour front desk · Good for drivers passing through, short business trips, or anyone keeping the room budget low to spend elsewhere · But if you want a room in better condition and fuller service for not much more, compare it with other budget hotels in town first.

A tip from following the reviews here: call the hotel directly first (tel. 082-867-0150) to check availability, fan vs. AC pricing and the condition of the room, since it is a small property where the rate moves with room type · If you self-drive, there is parking and easy access · And if you fancy paying respects, Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park is nearby — an easy stop before you head on.

faq.q: Where is Zwahotel Amnatcharoen, and what is nearby?
faq.a: Zwahotel Amnatcharoen is at 159 Moo 5, Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen · It is about 2 km (a ~5 minute drive) from the town centre and clock tower, and near Phra Mongkhon Ming Mueang Buddha Park (~3 km) · There are shops and a few eateries around for food.

faq.q: How much does Zwahotel Amnatcharoen cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: There are fan rooms (from about ฿260) and AC rooms (from about ฿320) · AC twin and superior rooms run roughly ฿360–฿400 · Rates vary by room type and season, so compare on Agoda before booking or call the hotel directly.

faq.q: Does Zwahotel Amnatcharoen have parking and a late check-in?
faq.a: Yes — there is parking and a 24-hour front desk, so late check-in is fine · It works for self-drivers or a stopover on an Isan road trip · There is free Wi-Fi in every room and an on-site mini-mart/shop.

faq.q: Who is Zwahotel Amnatcharoen best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone on a genuinely tight budget who just wants a cheap daily room for one night · Good for drivers passing through or short business trips · Not ideal for anyone expecting new rooms in good condition, polished service, or a walkable town-centre base.

faq.q: What condition are the rooms at Zwahotel Amnatcharoen in?
faq.a: Per the real reviews, rooms are simple and price-first, the building and rooms look old, and condition is uneven from room to room · It is a budget stay that trades simplicity for a low rate · It is worth calling to check room condition, or asking to see the room first if you can.

faq.q: Are there better options in Amnat Charoen for a similar budget?
faq.a: For a room in better condition without spending much more, compare it with Nakarin Hotel or Faikid Hotel, which reviews speak of more positively on cleanliness and service · But if the brief is the lowest price with fan rooms available, Zwahotel answers on price.
